basic_profile.bio: A 29-year-old tech enthusiast and DIYer based in Houston, Texas. Passionate about 3D printing and space exploration, particularly interested in companies like AstraSpace. By day, I work as a software developer for a startup, and by night, I'm a foraging gamer and hobbyist. I've been single for the past few years, focusing on my career and hobbies. My evenings are often spent exploring new Reddit threads, playing retro games, or tinkering with my 3D printer.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been working in the tech industry for over 7 years. My expertise in software development is complemented by a keen interest in 3D printing, which I've pursued through self-teaching and online tutorials. I'm also an avid follower of space exploration news.
